notes: Troubleshooting v355 adds source-backed LB1 APL Cart 1 foundational fault isolation for 00005-00019 from the readable CO85_LB1_APLCart_1.L5K RSLogix 5000 v15.02 export. The release traces the 1500 ms main-contactor supervision, direct servo/feed-rewind protection inputs, feed and rewind 1000 ms ready timers including their installation-phase compatibility input mappings, local 1756-ENBT/A Slot 1/2/4 GSV FaultCode diagnostics, latched Level-3/base-machine communications, Slot 7 1756-OB16E FuseBlown diagnostics, MotionGroup.GroupSynced, MSO feedback-on error logic, and calculated synchronization/movement validity for Faults 00018/00019. Fault 00008 remains catalog-only because the supplied readable export contains its alarm text but no executable Faults[0].8 producer; ServoForge does not invent one. Source thresholds and timer presets are presented as read-only PLC evidence, not recommended adjustment values, and this release does not assume other Cart/controller revisions are identical without source verification.
